description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Apple is hiring a Software Engineer to validate Apple Silicon through bare-metal system-level software that finds hardware bugs across pre- and post-silicon stages. The role develops SoC and CPU tests, maintains the system-level software platform, and works with designers and architects to meet validation goals.
SoC Validation Software Engineer developing SoC/CPU tests, debugging silicon issues, and maintaining system-level software platforms

Responsibilities:
• Develop SoC and CPU directed and random tests
• Debug issues pre-silicon or post-silicon
• Develop and maintain system-level SW platform
• Work with designers and architects to accomplish validation goals

Requirements:
• BS, MS or PhD in EE or CS

Preferred:
• SOC and CPU knowledge; consider the following: Micro-architecture, Memory hierarchy, Interrupt and DMA, Clock and Power Gating, System level understanding, & Experience with SoC bringup
• C/C++ and Assembly language programmer
• Knowledge of Hardware and Software debug tools and methods
• Experience with embedded programming with an understanding of hardware-software interfaces
